maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The uppermost keypoints are distributed with a wider lateral spacing compared to the dense row immediately below, situated at a superior-lateral offset of approximately 15 to 20 degrees relative to the medial axis of the muzzle.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The rhinarium exhibits approximately 25-30% melanin saturation, with dark pigmentation localized primarily along the superior-lateral margins and within the nostrils, while the central apex and philtrum region remain predominantly pinkish-tan.
